title: A mystery package and a QR card
scenario: A package you never ordered arrives with a note: “Scan to see who sent your gift.” The QR code opens a page asking you to sign in with your email before revealing the sender.

answers.A: Sign in if the package label has your correct name and address, since that proves the sender had your details.
answers.B: Do not sign in; verify the package through the retailer/carrier if possible and treat the QR code as untrusted.
answers.C: Scan only with a security-aware camera/browser and inspect the destination without entering any credentials.

explanation: Unsolicited packages can be used to lure recipients into malicious QR flows. Your address may already be public or breached.
proTip: A package can be physical bait for a digital trap.
